reviews.name: TONY
reviews.comment: My house was built in 1940 and still has galvinzed pipes, i need a simple cartridge replacement in my bathtub two plumbers came out 1. from mullen plumbing came by and was there for 3 min and said we have to cut open the wall upgrade the pipes and then we can replace the cartridge at the same time,$1800. 2nd plumber (prodigy plumbing) did the same thing, this charge was for $3500.00.  almost gave up, did 1 last search and found this GEM PETES PLUMBING.  Quick, responsive and provided us options. long story short Ron and Pete's plumbing resolved my issue without cutting any walls open and we now have cold/hot water running.  highly recommend PETES Plumbing and now they gained a new customer.

reviews.name: Nick Sramek - Personal Residence
reviews.comment: I was notified when they were on the way and who I should expect.  Great.  The two men were very efficient and clean.  They replaced the faucet and other hardware underneath so everything is new and clean looking.  They cleaned up and left.  They were very nice and courteous and like I said, cleaned up so you didn't know they had been there.  Thanks to them.

reviews.name: Loretta & Gary Hymel
reviews.comment: Very impressed with Shiloh's expertise and professionalism. He was extremely knowledgeable with excellent communication skills, answering and explaining any concerns or questions that we had. He exemplified a common sense and an experienced grasp of his craft. Very satisfied with his resolution of the tasks, meeting all of our expectations. Thank you for the AA++ customer service.

reviews.name: Stephanie
reviews.comment: My house is 98 this year. The repairs it has needed over the 25 years I've owned it have made me feel 98 too. However, I have been working with Pete's for many of those years for both plumbing and replacing my ancient floor furnace.  I cannot emphasize enough how helpful, honest, and understanding this company is. They explain everything clearly, do trustworthy and never unnecessary work, and have been incredibly patient working with me through a complicated and difficult situation. I have recommended them to everyone I know in LB and have been so grateful to be working with real people who are consistent and with whom I can have a long working relationship.  Don't bother calling anyone else.
